svg.title: Baron Levelwell

text.font-family: Fredoka, 'Baloo 2', Nunito, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif

svg.text: Leader of the Flatteners. Long grey coat, the flattest cap in Brickabrac, a bubble-level monocle, tea always in hand.

svg.text: Palette: coat grey #8A90A2, deep #5B6172, cap #3E4250, brass #E0AE3E,
He never bends. When beaten, only his cap tilts. The tea never spills.
